data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 claims to SHARE MECHANISM with 'SRC_001's token-economy analysis,' but SRC_001's content as presented contains no token-economy analysis whatsoever — it describes an abstraction relation from a formal harness specification governed by adjudication loops and HV-floor/lineage-ref programs. There is no mention of token budgets, selection pressure on candidate depth, or economic constraints on reasoning. The shared-mechanism relation is therefore built on a fabricated characterization of the endpoint: the proposed mechanism (budget-pressure causal loop) does not exist in the cited source, making the relation non-substantive rather than a genuine connection.
